correctness.rationale: A three-plant pollinator network is parametrized exactly by seven nonnegative type counts. Each pollinator is adjacent to one nonempty subset of three plants; the exact degree and connectedness criteria exhaust the graph class. Variance of all-neighbors-lost indicators reduces under dual degree matching to difference of union-size polynomials with union sizes n minus exclusive-pollinator counts. The exact 17,017 connected type-vector census through n=10 includes 1,529 comparisons, whose transformed polynomial coefficient vectors each have a single weak sign. This proves no real q in (0,1) can reverse variance ranking for n<=10. The n=11 matrices have the same two degree multisets and give 2q^6(1-q)^2(q^3+q^2-1); monotonic cubic provides one and only one positive crossover. Independent expansion of 2048 primary-loss masks per witness reproduces the variance identity. The enumerated proof covers only the stated finite sizes and does not infer unbounded conclusions.

originality.rationale: The accepted claim is the sharp eleven-pollinator onset of variance-ranking reversals at exactly three plants, not the generally known role of overlap nor the existence of variance reversals for other guild sizes. The exact seven-type small-size exclusion, fixed three-plant constraint, and reciprocal-plastic-constant witness are not consequences of any material inspected source. Related existing findings with larger plant guilds do not imply this fixed-three-plant minimum. Source-based priority uncertainty persists.

value.rationale: With exactly three plants, there are three distinct pairwise coextinction covariance channels; the first network size at which coextinction volatility rankings can change while both guild-degree distributions and the entire expected loss curve stay fixed is an ecologically natural exact cutoff. Eleven pollinators, not fewer, is a nontrivial, independently checkable structural minimum; the reciprocal-plastic-constant crossing supplies an exact risk regime boundary, not an arbitrary numeric example. This finding does not claim to discover generic covariance or network topology effects, nor does it extrapolate to empirical persistence, rewiring, heterogeneous risks or cascading dynamics.
